up: Retrieve a list of compounds tested against the human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL2007625). For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES string. The compounds must have at least one bioactivity record associated with this target.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2007625'
